description: Imperial burgundy floor-length court gown over cream linen, with a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and gold woven borders at neckline, cuffs, waist, front and hem. Small round gold belt clasps secure the waist. A cream-plum wrap with gold borders rests on the arms; pendant necklace, earrings, bracelet, rings and decorated gold flats complete the outfit.
